### Primaquine regimens by G6PD status

| G6PD category | Radical-cure treatment policy | Treatment implementation | Follow-up approach | Follow-up implementation |
|---|---|---|---|---|
| **G6PD normal male: no definition** | PQ 0.5 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Partially implemented | DOT | Not implemented, but patient clinical monitoring is conducted by care giver at home, as advised by the nurse |
| **G6PD normal female: no definition** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Partially implemented | DOT | Not implemented, but patient clinical monitoring is conducted by care giver at home, as advised by the nurse |
| **G6PD deficient: no definition** | No PQ or PQ 0.75 mg/kg/week weekly for 8 weeks | Implemented | DOT | Not implemented, but patient clinical monitoring is conducted by care giver at home, as advised by the nurse |
| **If no testing available** | PQ 0.25 mg/kg/day over 14 days | Implemented | DOT | Not implemented, but patient clinical monitoring is conducted by care giver at home, as advised by the nurse |
